words.defn_en: great trouble or difficulty

sentences.en: She showed remarkable strength in the face of ______.
sentences.zh: 面對逆境,她展現出驚人的堅強意志。

sentences.en: The team grew closer through shared ______ during the tough season.
sentences.zh: 在這個艱難的賽季中,這支隊伍因共同經歷的逆境而變得更加團結。

words.defn_en: to promote a product, service, or event publicly:

sentences.en: The startup spent most of its budget to ______ the new app on social media.
sentences.zh: 這家新創公司把大部分預算花在社群媒體宣傳新應用程式上。

sentences.en: Local shops ______ their weekend sales with flyers posted around town.
sentences.zh: 當地商店在城裡張貼傳單,宣傳週末的特賣活動。

words.defn_en: to recommend or give guidance:

sentences.en: I ______ you to study for the exam.
sentences.zh: 我建議你為考試做準備。

sentences.en: The doctor ______ him to get more rest.
sentences.zh: 醫生建議他多休息。

words.defn_en: to be in favor of, support:

sentences.en: The doctor continues to ______ regular exercise for all her patients.
sentences.zh: 這位醫生持續向她所有的病人提倡規律運動。

sentences.en: Environmental groups ______ stricter laws to reduce pollution.
sentences.zh: 環保團體提倡制定更嚴格的法律以減少污染。

words.defn_en: friendliness and ease of approach:

sentences.en: The new manager's ______ quickly won over the entire team.
sentences.zh: 新任經理的和藹可親很快就贏得了全體團隊的心。

sentences.en: Behind his ______ lay a sharp, calculating mind.
sentences.zh: 在他和藹可親的外表下,藏著敏銳而精於算計的頭腦。

words.defn_en: easy to talk to; easy to approach, friendly; kind

sentences.en: The new manager had an ______ personality that put everyone at ease.
sentences.zh: 這位新任經理個性和藹可親,讓每個人都感到自在。

sentences.en: Despite his fame, the actor remained ______ and down-to-earth.
sentences.zh: 儘管聲名遠播,這位演員依然和藹親切、腳踏實地。

words.defn_en: to influence or produce a change in; a person's outward emotional expression:

sentences.en: The new tax law will ______ small business owners the most.
sentences.zh: 這項新稅法對小企業主的影響最大。

sentences.en: The therapist noted the patient's flat ______ during the entire session.
sentences.zh: 治療師注意到病人整場療程中情感表現都很平淡。

words.defn_en: a spontaneous feeling of closeness:

sentences.en: She has always felt a strong ______ for animals.
sentences.zh: 她一直對動物有著強烈的親近感。

sentences.en: The two artists share a natural ______ for surrealist imagery.
sentences.zh: 這兩位藝術家對超現實主義的意象有著天生的親近感。

words.defn_en: to state as a fact; to declare strongly:

sentences.en: The witness ______ that she saw the suspect at the scene.
sentences.zh: 這名證人確認她曾在現場看見嫌疑人。

sentences.en: The court decided to ______ the lower court's ruling.
sentences.zh: 法院決定維持下級法院的判決。

words.defn_en: inspired, as if breathed upon by a divine or creative force:

sentences.en: The poet, seemingly ______ , finished the entire sonnet in a single sitting.
sentences.zh: 這位詩人彷彿受到靈感啟發,一口氣就寫完了整首十四行詩。

sentences.en: Critics described the young composer's symphony as strangely ______ , unlike anything he had written before.
sentences.zh: 評論家形容這位年輕作曲家的交響曲彷彿神來之筆,與他過去的作品截然不同。

words.defn_en: a sudden burst of creative inspiration:

sentences.en: A single sunset gave the painter enough ______ to fill three canvases.
sentences.zh: 一次日落就給了這位畫家足夠的靈感,畫滿了三幅畫布。

sentences.en: She waited months for the ______ that finally let her finish the novel's ending.
sentences.zh: 她等了好幾個月,終於等到讓她完成小說結局的靈感湧現。

words.defn_en: a divine creative impulse or inspiration:

sentences.en: The composer claimed his best symphonies came from a kind of ______ he could not control.
sentences.zh: 這位作曲家聲稱他最好的交響曲來自一種他無法掌控的神來靈感。

sentences.en: Without the ______ of his earlier years, his later paintings felt mechanical.
sentences.zh: 少了早年那種神授般的靈感,他晚期的畫作顯得機械而缺乏生氣。

words.defn_en: to trouble greatly, distress:

sentences.en: The disease continues to ______ millions of people around the world.
sentences.zh: 這種疾病持續折磨著全世界數百萬人。

sentences.en: Severe headaches have ______ed her for most of her adult life.
sentences.zh: 劇烈的頭痛困擾了她大半的成年生活。

words.defn_en: a state of pain, distress, or suffering; something causing this:

sentences.en: He bore his ______ with quiet dignity for over a decade.
sentences.zh: 十多年來,他以沉靜的尊嚴承受著自己的病痛。

sentences.en: Poverty remains a widespread ______ in many rural regions.
sentences.zh: 貧窮在許多鄉村地區仍是普遍的苦難。

words.defn_en: the state of having a great deal of money; wealth:

sentences.en: The neighborhood's sudden ______ was obvious from its newly paved streets and manicured lawns.
sentences.zh: 這個社區突然變得富裕,從新鋪的街道和修剪整齊的草坪就能看出來。

sentences.en: Despite his ______ , he still drove the same old car he had in college.
sentences.zh: 儘管他很富有,卻仍開著大學時代的那輛舊車。

words.defn_en: rich:

sentences.en: They live in an ______ neighborhood filled with large houses and expensive cars.
sentences.zh: 他們住在一個滿是豪宅與名車的富裕社區。

sentences.en: Her ______ parents paid for her entire college education.
sentences.zh: 她那富裕的父母支付了她全部的大學學費。

words.defn_en: an insult:

sentences.en: He took the harsh criticism as a personal ______.
sentences.zh: 他將這項嚴厲的批評視為一種個人的冒犯。

sentences.en: Being excluded from the meeting felt like a deliberate ______.
sentences.zh: 被排除在會議之外,讓他覺得像是刻意的侮辱。

words.defn_en: to increase or make greater:

sentences.en: The general used the victory to ______ his own reputation.
sentences.zh: 這位將軍利用這場勝利來誇大自己的聲望。

sentences.en: Critics accused the CEO of trying to ______ his own image at the company's expense.
sentences.zh: 批評者指控這位執行長犧牲公司利益,只為抬高自己的形象。

words.defn_en: the action of increasing one's own power, status, or wealth:

sentences.en: Critics accused the general of using the war for personal ______.
sentences.zh: 評論家指責這位將軍利用戰爭謀取個人權勢。

sentences.en: The charity's mission was undermined by the director's obvious self-______.
sentences.zh: 這位主任明顯的自我膨脹,損害了慈善機構的宗旨。

words.defn_en: to worsen or intensify:

sentences.en: Scratching the rash will only ______ it.
sentences.zh: 抓癢只會使這片皮疹更加惡化。

sentences.en: Stress can ______ existing health problems.
sentences.zh: 壓力可能會使原有的健康問題更加惡化。

words.defn_en: a sum total or mixture

sentences.en: The report presents the ______ of all survey responses collected.
sentences.zh: 這份報告呈現了所收集到的所有調查回應的總和。

sentences.en: In ______, the company's regional sales exceeded expectations.
sentences.zh: 整體加總來看,這家公司的區域銷售表現超出了預期。

words.defn_en: forceful or overly assertive:

sentences.en: The man's ______ tone made everyone uneasy.
sentences.zh: 這個男人咄咄逼人的語氣讓大家都感到不安。

sentences.en: The company adopted an ______ marketing strategy to boost sales.
sentences.zh: 這家公司採取了積極進取的行銷策略以提升銷售額。

words.defn_en: to cause distress or grief to; to treat unjustly:

sentences.en: The new policy will ______ thousands of long-time employees who lose their pensions.
sentences.zh: 這項新政策將讓數千名資深員工因失去退休金而受到委屈。

sentences.en: She felt deeply ______ by her colleague's public accusation.
sentences.zh: 同事公開的指控讓她深感委屈。

words.defn_en: distressed, wronged, injured:

sentences.en: The ______ employees filed a formal complaint against their manager.
sentences.zh: 這些感到委屈的員工對經理提出了正式申訴。

sentences.en: She felt deeply ______ after being passed over for the promotion.
sentences.zh: 在升遷機會落空後,她感到深深的委屈。

words.defn_en: related on the father's side; a relative through male descent:

sentences.en: Under the old inheritance law, only ______ relatives could claim the estate.
sentences.zh: 根據舊時的繼承法,只有父系親屬才能主張這筆遺產。

sentences.en: The genealogist traced his ______ line back seven generations.
sentences.zh: 這位家譜學家追溯他父系的血脈,一路回溯了七代。

words.defn_en: a claim or assertion, typically without proof:

sentences.en: The company denied the ______ of financial fraud.
sentences.zh: 該公司否認了財務詐欺的指控。

sentences.en: Reporters could not confirm the ______ before the story went to print.
sentences.zh: 在報導刊出前,記者無法證實這項指控。

words.defn_en: to assert, usually without proof:

sentences.en: Prosecutors ______ that the company knowingly sold defective products.
sentences.zh: 檢察官指稱這家公司在明知情況下販售瑕疵產品。

sentences.en: The witness continued to ______ that she saw the defendant at the scene.
sentences.zh: 這位證人持續指稱她看見被告出現在案發現場。

words.defn_en: to make easier, lighten:

sentences.en: The medicine helped ______ her headache within an hour.
sentences.zh: 這種藥物在一小時內就幫助緩解了她的頭痛。

sentences.en: The new policy aims to ______ poverty in rural areas.
sentences.zh: 這項新政策旨在減輕農村地區的貧困問題。

words.defn_en: the repetition of the same initial consonant sound in nearby words:

sentences.en: The poet used heavy ______ in the line "the wild wind whipped the waves."
sentences.zh: 詩人在「the wild wind whipped the waves」這句中大量使用了頭韻。

sentences.en: Advertisers often rely on ______ to make slogans more memorable, as in "Coca-Cola."
sentences.zh: 廣告商常靠頭韻讓標語更容易記住,例如「Coca-Cola」。

words.defn_en: characterized by the repetition of initial consonant sounds:

sentences.en: The tongue twister's ______ structure makes it hard to say quickly.
sentences.zh: 這句繞口令的頭韻結構使它很難快速唸出來。

sentences.en: Old English epic poetry relied heavily on ______ verse rather than rhyme.
sentences.zh: 古英語史詩大量仰賴頭韻詩體,而非押韻。

words.defn_en: to distribute, set aside:

sentences.en: The city plans to ______ more funding for public schools next year.
sentences.zh: 這座城市計畫明年為公立學校分配更多經費。

sentences.en: Managers must carefully ______ their team's time across multiple projects.
sentences.zh: 經理人必須謹慎地將團隊的時間分配到多個專案之中。

words.defn_en: to hint, suggest:

sentences.en: She ______d to a past mistake without giving any specific details.
sentences.zh: 她隱約提及了一個過去的錯誤,卻沒有透露任何具體細節。

sentences.en: The professor ______d to a theory he would explain fully next week.
sentences.zh: 教授提到了一個他下週會完整說明的理論。

words.defn_en: an indirect reference, often to literature

sentences.en: The poem contains a subtle ______ to a Greek myth.
sentences.zh: 這首詩隱約暗指了一則希臘神話。

sentences.en: The author made an ______ to Shakespeare's "Hamlet" in the title.
sentences.zh: 這位作者在標題中暗指了莎士比亞的《哈姆雷特》。

words.defn_en: to relieve, improve:

sentences.en: The new policy aims to ______ working conditions in factories.
sentences.zh: 這項新政策旨在改善工廠的工作條件。

sentences.en: Better drainage systems could ______ the flooding in the area.
sentences.zh: 更完善的排水系統可以改善這個地區的淹水問題。

words.defn_en: the process of making something better:

sentences.en: The report proposed several measures for the ______ of working conditions.
sentences.zh: 這份報告提出了幾項改善工作環境的措施。

sentences.en: Slow ______ of the water supply came only after years of complaints.
sentences.zh: 在多年的抱怨之後,供水情況才逐漸得到改善。

words.defn_en: intended to make a situation better:

sentences.en: The government introduced ______ policies to ease the housing crisis.
sentences.zh: 政府推出改善性的政策,以緩解房屋危機。

sentences.en: Doctors prescribed an ______ course of treatment rather than a full cure.
sentences.zh: 醫生開出的是改善性的療程,而非徹底治癒的方案。

words.defn_en: willing, compliant:

sentences.en: The manager was ______ to adjusting the schedule for new parents.
sentences.zh: 這位經理很願意配合為新手父母調整班表。

sentences.en: He is usually ______ to reasonable requests from his employees.
sentences.zh: 他通常都很樂於配合員工合理的要求。

words.defn_en: capable of being changed or corrected:

sentences.en: The contract's terms are ______ if both parties agree in writing.
sentences.zh: 只要雙方書面同意,合約條款是可以修改的。

sentences.en: Fortunately, the error in the report was easily ______.
sentences.zh: 幸好報告裡的錯誤很容易修改。

words.defn_en: compensation given for a wrong or injury done:

sentences.en: He tried to make ______ for his rudeness by helping her move the following week.
sentences.zh: 他隔週幫忙她搬家,試圖為自己的無禮做出彌補。

sentences.en: The company offered a refund as ______ for the delayed shipment.
sentences.zh: 這家公司提供退款,作為延遲出貨的賠償。

words.defn_en: to incorporate territory or space:

sentences.en: The empire moved to ______ the small neighboring kingdom.
sentences.zh: 這個帝國採取行動,併吞了鄰近的小王國。

sentences.en: The company built an ______ to house its growing warehouse operations.
sentences.zh: 這家公司蓋了一座附屬建築,以容納日益擴大的倉儲作業。

words.defn_en: to add explanatory notes or comments to a text or diagram:

sentences.en: The teacher asked us to ______ the passage with notes about its themes.
sentences.zh: 老師要求我們為這段文章加上關於主題的註解。

sentences.en: Please ______ the medical text with your observations.
sentences.zh: 請在這份醫學文本上加註你的觀察意見。

words.defn_en: a note added to a text to explain or comment on it:

sentences.en: The professor's ______ in the margin clarified a confusing passage.
sentences.zh: 教授在頁邊寫的註解,釐清了一段令人困惑的文字。

sentences.en: Each chapter includes historical ______ to give readers context.
sentences.zh: 每個章節都附有歷史注解,為讀者提供背景脈絡。

words.defn_en: to make a public statement:

sentences.en: The CEO will ______ the new policy tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 執行長明天將宣布這項新政策。

sentences.en: They plan to ______ their engagement at the family dinner.
sentences.zh: 他們計畫在家庭聚餐上宣布訂婚的消息。

words.defn_en: to make void or invalid:

sentences.en: The couple decided to ______ their marriage after only a few months.
sentences.zh: 這對夫妻結婚才幾個月就決定辦理婚姻無效。

sentences.en: The court moved to ______ the unfair contract.
sentences.zh: 法院著手廢除這份不公平的合約。

words.defn_en: shocked, dismayed:

sentences.en: She was ______ by the conditions in which the animals were kept.
sentences.zh: 看到這些動物被飼養的環境,她感到十分震驚。

sentences.en: He was ______ at how carelessly they had handled the situation.
sentences.zh: 他們處理這件事的草率態度讓他感到十分駭然。

words.defn_en: inspiring shock, horror, disgust:

sentences.en: The conditions in the abandoned factory were truly ______.
sentences.zh: 這座廢棄工廠的環境狀況實在令人震驚。

sentences.en: Reporters described the aftermath of the storm as ______.
sentences.zh: 記者形容這場暴風雨過後的景象十分駭人。

words.defn_en: to make tranquil, especially by giving into demands; pacify

sentences.en: The government offered tax cuts to ______ angry voters.
sentences.zh: 政府提出減稅方案,以平息憤怒選民的不滿。

sentences.en: He tried to ______ his sister by apologizing for the mess.
sentences.zh: 他試圖透過為這場混亂道歉來安撫姊姊。

words.defn_en: a name:=epithet

sentences.en: The city earned the ______ 'the Big Apple' many decades ago.
sentences.zh: 這座城市在數十年前獲得了「大蘋果」這個稱號。

sentences.en: His formal ______ was rarely used except on official documents.
sentences.zh: 他的正式稱謂除了在正式文件上,很少被使用。

words.defn_en: a section of supplementary material at the end of a book; a small organ near the intestine:

sentences.en: The technical data was placed in an ______ so it wouldn't clutter the main text.
sentences.zh: 為了不讓正文顯得雜亂,技術數據被放進附錄裡。

sentences.en: He was rushed to the hospital when his ______ became inflamed.
sentences.zh: 他的闌尾發炎時被緊急送醫。

words.defn_en: to show approval by clapping; to praise:

sentences.en: The audience stood to ______ the orchestra's flawless performance.
sentences.zh: 觀眾起立鼓掌,讚賞管弦樂團完美無瑕的演出。

sentences.en: Critics ______ the film's bold approach to a difficult subject.
sentences.zh: 評論家讚揚這部電影對這個艱難主題的大膽處理方式。
